parsed.visual_overview: A mixed-media narrative following Rahul, whose head is digitally enlarged for a caricature effect. We see his journey from a struggling, underconfident data entry worker failing an interview, to practicing English on his phone, and finally succeeding in a new interview with full confidence.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: Salary 12 हज़ार और खर्चा 11 हज़ार 990. बचते इतने कम हैं कि वो खुद के लिए कुछ कर ही नहीं पाता.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Salary 12 hazaar aur kharcha 11 hazaar 990. Bachte itne kam hain ki woh khud ke liye kuch kar hi nahi paata.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: ये कहानी है राहुल की. कानपुर का रहने वाला, age 24. Data entry की job. रोज़ का routine: office, घर, reels, और नींद. सपने बड़े थे, पर English आती नहीं थी.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Yeh kahani hai Rahul ki. Kanpur ka rehne wala, age 24. Data entry ki job. Roz ka routine: office, ghar, reels, aur neend. Sapne bade the, par English aati nahi thi.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: एक दिन MNC interview मिला. Interviewer ने पूछा, "Tell me about yourself." राहुल completely blank. 30 seconds silence. फिर डर के बोला...
Rahul says: (nervously) Sir... मैं राहुल हूँ... मैं काम करता हूँ...
Miss Nova says: Interviewer हँसा और बोला "Thank you." Call कभी नहीं आई.
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Ek din MNC interview mila. Interviewer ne pucha, "Tell me about yourself." Rahul completely blank. 30 seconds silence. Phir darr ke bola...
Rahul says: (nervously) Sir... main Rahul hoon... main kaam karta hoon...
Miss Nova says: Interviewer hansa aur bola "Thank you." Call kabhi nahi aayi.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: उस रात reels scroll करते हुए उसने Supernova AI app देखा. एक AI teacher—यानी मैं—जो बिना judge किए mistakes live correct करती, और सब कुछ Hindi में समझाती. पहले ही दिन उसने सीखा, "How to introduce yourself."
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Uss raat reels scroll karte hue usne Supernova AI app dekha. Ek AI teacher—yaani main—jo bina judge kiye mistakes live correct karti, aur sab kuch Hindi mein samjhati. Pehle hi din usne seekha, "How to introduce yourself."

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: उस दिन से reels की जगह रोज़ 10-15 minutes उसने मेरे साथ speaking practice की. हज़ार mistakes की, पर मैंने तुरंत correct की.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Uss din se reels ki jagah roz 10-15 minutes usne mere saath speaking practice ki. Hazaar mistakes ki, par maine turant correct ki.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: सिर्फ 30 days बाद, फिर से interview. "Tell me about yourself."
Rahul says: (confidently) Good morning sir. My name is Rahul. I have experience in data entry...
Miss Nova says: Confidence full, select! Salary 28 हज़ार. क्या बदला? सिर्फ रोज़ के 15 minutes.
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Sirf 30 days baad, phir se interview. "Tell me about yourself."
Rahul says: (confidently) Good morning sir. My name is Rahul. I have experience in data entry...
Miss Nova says: Confidence full, select! Salary 28 hazaar. Kya badla? Sirf roz ke 15 minutes.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: India में 1 crore से ज़्यादा लोग मेरे साथ English बोलने की practice कर रहे हैं. आज ही Supernova AI download कीजिए!
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: India mein 1 crore se zyada log mere saath English bolne ki practice kar rahe hain. Aaj hi Supernova AI download kijiye!
